name: Magna Glaze

features.text: easy application by hand or high speed and orbital buffers.

description: A one-step polish for use on all painted surfaces. It removes medium oxidation, cleans, polishes, and protects. Magna Glaze™ is a thick cream with an off-white color (similar to Magna Bright #21403, but more aggressive).
application: Hand Use: Dampen a clean cloth or applicator and spread Magna Glaze ™ on cloth or vehicle surface. Apply product using even pressure and circular motion. Allow to dry. Use a clean towel to wipe clean. Machine Use: Squirt Magna Bright™ onto vehicle surface. For best results, use an all-wool finish pad. Apply medium to heavy pressure at first, then gradually ease up until polish dries and develops a gloss. For extended protection and additional gloss, apply a finish wax as a final operation. Can be used with all-wool and foam pads.
review: Has a Performance Ratings section: Abrasiveness - 6 Gloss - 5 Durability - 4
